nodes.title: README · Infinite Movie
widgets_values:
# Infinite Movie

Turns a few stills into one seamless, looping film. The MiniMax H3 engine renders one shot per transition between two images; *Assemble* evens out the motion and joins the shots into the final film.

Node pack: https://github.com/metamountain/comfyui-infinite-movie (by metamountain). Feedback and issues welcome.

## How to read this workflow
Left: this README. Top: **1 · Engine** (MiniMax H3). Below it ONE row, read left to right – each area has its help note on top:
2. **Settings** – LLM (one dropdown), size, output folder, film name.
3. **Images** – load your stills (add more: they grow downwards).
4. **Prompts** – *Prompt Style* (what the LLM is told, max words, camera) on top, then one *Auto Prompt* per transition.
5. **Director** – seconds per shot, loop, variants. Click **AUTO LAYOUT** after changes.
6. **Choose** – with variants: pick A or B per shot.
7. **Assemble + Film** – joins the shots, shows the finished film, *Open folder*.

The settings are passed along one chain: Settings → Prompt Style → Auto Prompts → Director → Assemble.
Before a render starts, Run frees the GPU (unloads the LLM); if it cannot, the render is not queued and a message says why.

Other engines: open **Infinite Movie - Engine LTX 2.5** or **Infinite Movie - Engine Wan 2.2**, copy its group (Ctrl+C), paste it here (Ctrl+V) and mute the MiniMax group (Ctrl+M) – only ONE engine group may be active.

## Required tools
- ffmpeg (encoding/joining films): usually already there via `imageio-ffmpeg` (installed with VideoHelperSuite), otherwise https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/ (Windows) or https://ffmpeg.org/download.html – put `ffmpeg` on PATH.
- VideoHelperSuite: https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite

## Models – MiniMax H3 (default engine)
- diffusion_models: [minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)
- loras: [minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.1_768p_comfyui_bf16](https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo/resolve/main/minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.1_768p_comfyui_bf16.safetensors)
- text_encoders (CLIPLoader type `minimax`): [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)
- vae: [minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_int8_convrot.safetensors) · [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)
- Model page: https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3

## Optional
- LTX IC-LoRA pixel upscaler + https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo
- Low VRAM (12–16 GB, untested by us): community LTX-2.5 GGUF + https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF

**Tested on:** RTX 24 GB, 768×960, single shots up to 60 s (1441 frames).

nodes.title: Help: 3 · Images
widgets_values:
## 3 · Images
Your stills, top to bottom = order in the film.
- **Load Image** → Director `image 1`, `image 2`, …
- More or fewer images: set Director › `images` – new Load Images (copy of the last image) and their Auto Prompts are added and laid out automatically. Then replace the copies with your pictures.
- Leave an image out: select it, Ctrl+M (mute).

nodes.title: Help: 4 · Prompts
widgets_values:
## 4 · Prompts
- **Prompt Style** (top): what the prompt model is told, `max_words`, `camera`. Applies to all Auto Prompts.
- **Auto Prompt** (one per transition, sits between its two images): type a few words into `keywords`, press **🔄 Regenerate prompt** – the model looks at both images and writes `prompt`. Edit it freely; Run never rewrites it.
- Output `prompt` → Director; `settings ▶ chain` → next node.

nodes.title: Help: 2 · Settings
widgets_values:
## 2 · Settings
One node for the whole workflow.
- `prompt_model`: local vision model that writes the prompts (Qwen3-VL in `models/text_encoders`); `off` = write them yourself.
- `aspect` + `long_side`: picture size (both sides rounded to 32; 4:5 + 960 = 768×960).
- `output_folder` (**📂 Choose folder**) and `film_name`: where the film goes and what it is called.
- `audio`: sound from the engine (off = faster, silent film).
- **📦 Check models**: lists missing model files with their size and downloads them.
- Output `settings ▶ chain` → Prompt Style.

nodes.title: Help: 5 · Director
widgets_values:
## 5 · Director
Turns images + prompts into shots.
- `images`: number of images (adds or mutes Load Image + Auto Prompt, then lays out).
- `seconds` per shot, `loop` (last image back to the first), `variants` (2 = render A and B, pick in Choose), `seed`.
- **🔗 AUTO LAYOUT**: tidies all groups.
- Output `shots ▶ Assemble` → Choose.

nodes.title: Help: 6 · Choose
widgets_values:
## 6 · Choose
Check the shots before the film is built.
- Hover plays a shot; click picks it (A/B with `variants` = 2). **✓ KEEP / ✗ REDO** per shot; red *⚠ HARD CUT / SEAM* marks bad joins.
- **✎ prompt** / **⏱ seconds** change one shot and mark it REDO.
- Big button: **ASSEMBLE ▶** builds the film, **RERENDER n ↻** renders only the marked shots.
- Output `shots` → Assemble.

nodes.title: Help: 7 · Assemble + Film
widgets_values:
## 7 · Assemble + Film
- **Assemble**: joins the shots. `even_motion` evens out the motion (`strength`, `keep`), `interpolate` RIFE x2, `output_size`. Viewer: Graph · Timeline · Heatmap · Frames · Particles · Sheet. Sound only with `even_motion` off.
- **Film**: plays the finished film, shows where it was saved, **📂 Open folder**.

nodes.title: Help: 8 · Upscale
widgets_values:
## 8 · Upscale (optional)
- Off by default. **Select the group, Ctrl+M** turns it on.
- Then **ASSEMBLE** also renders an upscaled film: model upscale (Upscale Crop Universal) + **LTX Refine** 1:1 (prompt `photographic, 4k`), with the film's sound.
- The second **Film** node shows the upscaled version.

nodes.title: Help: 1 · Engine: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## 1 · Engine: MiniMax H3
Renders one shot (start image → end image) per call from the Director. MiniMax H3 first/last-frame, int8, **8-step turbo LoRA v1.1** (768p), video + sound.
- **Infinite Movie · Engine Start** (from Director): `start_image`, `end_image`, `prompt`, `seed`, `width`, `height`, `length`.
- **UNETLoader + Turbo LoRA 8 steps**: H3 model + LoRA (strength 1). Without the LoRA: bypass it, 20–25 steps.
- **CLIPLoader** (type `minimax`): Qwen3-VL 32B text encoder. **VAELoader** ×2: video + audio VAE.
- **MiniMax H3 Image To Video**: first/last frame, prompt, size and length from Engine Start (last frame optional).
- **KSampler**: 8 steps, cfg 1, res_multistep, simple; seed from Engine Start. Negative = empty (ConditioningZeroOut), ignored at cfg 1.
- **Infinite Movie · Engine Result** (to Director): frames + sound, 24 fps, `length_grid` 17 (H3 snaps to 17k+5 frames).
- Sound is only kept when Settings › `audio` is on.
- Other engines: `Infinite Movie - Engine LTX 2.5` / `Infinite Movie - Engine Wan 2.2`. Only ONE engine group may be active; mute the other (select group, Ctrl+M).
